text_en: I appeal to you therefore, brothers and sisters, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship.
text_cn: 所以弟兄们！我以天主的仁慈请求你们，献上你们的身体当作生活、圣洁和悦乐天主的祭品：这才是你们合理的敬礼。

text_en: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your minds, so that you may discern what is the will of God—what is good and acceptable and perfect.
text_cn: 你们不可与此世同化，反而应以更新的心思变化自己，为使你们能辨别什么是天主的旨意，什么是善事，什么是悦乐天主的事，什么是成全的事。

text_en: For by the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith that God has assigned.
text_cn: 我因所赐给我的圣宠，告诉你们每一位：不可把自己估计得太高，而过了份；但应按照天主所分与各人的信德尺度，估计得适中。

text_en: For as in one body we have many members, and not all the members have the same function,
text_cn: 就如我们在一个身体上有许多肢体，但每个肢体，都有不同的作用；

text_en: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually we are members one of another.
text_cn: 同样，我们众人在基督内，也都是一个身体，彼此之间，每个都是肢体。

text_en: We have gifts that differ according to the grace given to us: prophecy, in proportion to faith;
text_cn: 按我们各人所受的圣宠，各有不同的恩赐：如果是说预言，就应与信德相符合；

text_en: ministry, in ministering; the teacher, in teaching;
text_cn: 如果是服务，就应用在服务上；如果是教导，就应用在教导上；

text_en: the exhorter, in exhortation; the giver, in generosity; the leader, in diligence; the compassionate, in cheerfulness.
text_cn: 如果是劝勉，就应用在劝勉上；施与的，应该大方；监督的应该殷勤；行慈善的，应该和颜悦色。

text_en: Let love be genuine; hate what is evil, hold fast to what is good;
text_cn: 爱情不可是虚伪的。你们当厌恶恶事，附和善事。

text_en: love one another with mutual affection; outdo one another in showing honor.
text_cn: 论兄弟之爱，要彼此相亲相爱；论尊敬，要彼此争先。

text_en: Do not lag in zeal, be ardent in spirit, serve the Lord.
text_cn: 论关怀，不可疏忽；论心神，要热切；对于主，要衷心事奉。

text_en: Rejoice in hope, be patient in suffering, persevere in prayer.
text_cn: 论望德，要喜乐；在困苦中，要忍耐；在祈祷上，要恒心；

text_en: Contribute to the needs of the saints; extend hospitality to strangers.
text_cn: 对圣者的急需，要分担；对客人，要款待。

text_en: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse them.
text_cn: 迫害你们的，要祝福；只可祝福，不可诅咒。

text_en: Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep.
text_cn: 应与喜乐的一同喜乐，与哭泣的一同哭泣。

text_en: Live in harmony with one another; do not be haughty, but associate with the lowly; do not claim to be wiser than you are.
text_cn: 彼此要同心合意，不可心高妄想，却要俯就卑微的人。不可自作聪明。

text_en: Do not repay anyone evil for evil, but take thought for what is noble in the sight of all.
text_cn: 对人不可以恶报恶，对众人要勉励行善；

text_en: If it is possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all.
text_cn: 如若可能，应尽力与众人和睦相处。

text_en: Beloved, never avenge yourselves, but leave room for the wrath of God; for it is written, “Vengeance is mine, I will repay, says the Lord. ”
text_cn: 诸位亲爱的，你们不可为自己复仇，但应给天主的忿怒留有余地，因为经上记载：“上主说：复仇是我的事，我必报复。”

text_en: No, “if your enemies are hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them something to drink; for by doing this you will heap burning coals on their heads. ”
text_cn: 所以：“如果你的仇人饿了，你要给他饭吃；渴了，应给他水喝，因为你这样作，是将炭火堆在他头上。”

text_en: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
text_cn: 你不可为恶所胜，反应以善胜恶。
